text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
After the race was over... my heart was 
full. I'm so glad we met "now." I'm so 
glad... you're my Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Being able to tell my Trainer—who works 
harder than anyone—'You're wonderful'... 
I'm glad it's now.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
As long as I'm with you, Trainer, I can 
move forward without fear. Let us go... to 
the Oaks...!
